sentences.text:
1. 
The revisional application has been preferred praying for quashing of proceedings in connection with S.C. Case No. 39 of 2024, corresponding to G.R. Case No.2281 of 2023 arising out of Beniapukur Police Station Case No. 230 of 2023 dated 21.09.2023 under Sections 376 / 417 / 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, and setting aside of the order dated 07.03.2025 passed by the learned Additional District Judge, Fast Track Court - I, Sealdah South 24 Parganas, in S.C. case no. 30 of 2024 (arising out of G.R. Case no. 2281 of 2023, corresponding to Beniapukur P.S. case no. 230 of 2023 dated 21.09.2023) whereby the learned court below was pleased to reject the petitioner's prayer for discharge under Section 227 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
2.

On hearing the learned counsel for the petitioner and on perusal of the materials on record including the written complaint at page 21 of the revisional application, it appears that the petitioner while being a major, prima facie, entered into a relationship with the opposite party no.2 and on perusal of the petition of complaint that there does not appear to be any allegation of forcible physical relationship.
It is when the complainant asked the petitioner to get married that the petitioner started avoiding her and that the present complaint has been lodged.
3. Considering the nature of allegation and materials on record, it appears that the petitioner has made out a prima facie case of hearing, accordingly, the matter be listed for hearing.
4. Petitioner is directed to serve upon the opposite parties.

pending before the learned Additional District Judge, Fast Track Court - I, Sealdah, South 24 Parganas, be stayed till 28th April, 2026 or until further order, whichever is earlier.
